yates_mentzer.label: Modified Yates / Mentzer
yates_mentzer.note: Low volume, high intensity, reps-before-load, RPE 9-10. The current default.

hit.label: Pure HIT / Heavy Duty (Mentzer)
hit.note: One all-out set to failure, minimal volume, no backoffs, long rest, bigger jumps when earned.

volume.label: High-Volume Hypertrophy (GVT-style)
volume.note: More sets, moderate RPE 8-9, higher rep ranges, smaller load jumps.

strength_rpt.label: Strength 5x5 / Reverse Pyramid
strength_rpt.note: Lower reps, bigger load jumps, lower RPE caps, more warmups; backoffs as ~10% drops.

5_3_1.label: 5/3/1 (Jim Wendler)
5_3_1.note: Training Max = 90% of an estimated 1RM (Epley-shaped heuristic; e1rm_reps_coefficient/training_max_rounding_lb engine constants are added by plan 05.3-04, not here). Canonical main-lift exercise_keys per this plan's Task 1 option-b ratification (2026-08-17, Chad Crawford, Program Director): no substitution -- squat/bench/press map to their canonical equipment_movement exercise identities (app/ontology/movement_cluster_map.json, app/ontology/exercise_identity_registry.py). All four main lifts have zero logged qualifying top sets in live session_sets data as of 2026-08-17, so the Training Max heuristic correctly refuses a number for every lift until at least one is actually trained -- intended RC-E discipline, not a defect. `deadlift`'s exercise_keys is deliberately empty: the only conventional-deadlift entry found in the ontology is the bare, unqualified string "deadlift" (movement_cluster_map.json's hip_hinge cluster), which breaks the equipment-qualified naming convention every other canonical exercise id in this codebase follows and has no corroborating entry in exercise_identity_registry.py or exercise_alias_map.json -- left unmapped per Task 1's own escape hatch rather than guessed. Follow-up: confirm a real canonical conventional-deadlift id when the ontology is extended.

linear_periodization.label: Linear Periodization (classic strength)
linear_periodization.note: Classic 12-week linear block: hypertrophy (wk1-4) -> strength (wk5-8) -> power/peak (wk9-12); intensity_basis=one_rm (not Training Max, no warmup_sets ratified for this profile). Canonical main-lift exercise_keys per this plan's Task 1 option-b ratification (2026-08-17, Chad Crawford, Program Director): no substitution, same mapping as 5_3_1. All four main lifts have zero logged qualifying top sets in live session_sets data as of 2026-08-17. `deadlift`'s exercise_keys is deliberately empty for the same reason documented on the 5_3_1 profile -- no confidently-canonical conventional-deadlift exercise id exists yet in this codebase's ontology.
